brand.name: Hockair
brand.title: Online air hockey, taken seriously.
brand.description: Train against bots, climb the ladder and take on the community every week, right in your browser.

bots.title: Cartoon bots in 3D
bots.description: Every opponent has its own play style and difficulty. Beat them all to unlock what comes next.

ranked.title: A ranked ladder
ranked.description: Every ranked win moves your rating. Track your progress match after match.

tournaments.title: Weekly tournaments
tournaments.description: Single-elimination brackets every week, with rewards for the top players.

brand.illustrationLabel: Illustration of an air hockey table

login.title: Welcome back
login.description: Sign in to pick up your progress, friends and tournaments.
login.guestLink: Play as a guest against bots
login.guestHint: Without an account, your progress stays on this device.

register.title: Create your account
register.description: Free. An account is required for ranked play, tournaments and friends.

success.title: Check your inbox
success.description: We sent an activation link to {email}. It is valid for one hour.

steps.open: Open the email sent by Hockair.
steps.login: Come back here and sign in.

success.devHint: Local environment: when no SMTP server is configured, the activation link is printed in the server console.

loading.title: Activating…
loading.description: We are checking your activation link.

success.title: Account activated
success.description: Your account is ready. Sign in to start playing.

alreadyActive.title: Account already active
alreadyActive.description: This account has already been activated. You can sign in right away.

error.title: Invalid or expired link
error.description: This activation link is no longer valid. Links expire after one hour: sign up again to receive a new one.

notFound.title: Account not found
notFound.description: No account matches this link. It may have been deleted.

server.title: Server unreachable
server.description: We cannot check your link right now. Try again in a moment.

language.title: Choose your language
language.description: You can change it at any time from the settings.

errors.emailInvalid: This email address is not valid.
errors.passwordWeak: The password does not meet every rule.
errors.emailTaken: An account already exists with this email address.
errors.server: The server is not responding. Try again in a moment.
